subtitulo: Run from your owner. No bath today!
comoJogarTeclado: Space or ↑ to jump · ↓ to duck
comoJogarToque: Tap or swipe up to jump · swipe down to duck
dica: Mud slows you down. Tissues clean you up.

orientacao.texto: Sideways you see more of the track, and obstacles give you more time.

abertura.pularTeclado: Click or press any key to skip the intro

fim.pego: Your owner caught you! Bath time 🛁
fim.queda: Splash! Into the water… bath taken 🛁
